text:
jordan: Infra wants a signer-only BYOK operator role (Sign/Verify only). Need custody, audit, and compliance checklist before we approve.
sarah: High level: enforce at HSM (never just proxy), require attestation snapshots, and short TTLs + dual admin grants.
mike: Implementation idea: proxy rejects Unwrap/Export; HSM ACL sets CKA_EXTRACTABLE=false. Need sample RBAC JSON for keystore-proxy.
sarah: Minimal RBAC: {role: signer_only, allow:[Sign,Verify], deny:[Unwrap,Export], approvals:2, ttl_hours:24, attestation_required:true}. Also fw_whitelist.
elaine: Ops: must emit structured audit: principal, op, session_id, hsm_slot, attestation_b64, fw_hash. Mirror to WORM storage for 90d.
sec-bot: Scan: 12 keys currently allow unwrap. Recommend 30d staged migration.
mike: Migration note: rewrap usually needs Unwrap on source; prefer HSM internal rewrap. If not supported, get customer consent + legal sign-off.
ana (legal): For EEA/banking customers we need DPA update + attestation artifacts and contract revocation SLA for operator compromise.
sarah: IR runbook update: evidence checklist (attestation blobs, HSM audit slices, operator auth traces) + preserve raw logs with checksums.
jordan: Action items: Mike PR proxy+RBAC (2w), Sarah update runbook & alerts (1w), Elaine provision WORM bucket (2w), Ana DPA wording (3d).
sec-bot: Created SEC-5001 (RBAC change) and SEC-5002 (audit retention).
